Chili peppers are field crops unlocked at experience level 25.

They are used to make many recipes, including salsa, which is used to make other products.

Like all crops, they are stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 540 coin.

Growing chili peppers

Chili peppers are grown in fields by planting another pepper (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 7 xp points, and takes 4 hours to mature.

Selling chili peppers

  • Chili peppers can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 360 coin for 10 units.

Boat orders

  • Boat orders ask for 4 to 13 chili per crate, up to a total of 52 per boat.
  • Each unit of chili pepper gives players 14 coins and 11 experience points in boat orders.

Strategy tips

  • Chili are uncommon enough that selling them at a lower price is not necessary.
  • Chili can very often be found in the Daily Dirt, and sells very quickly.
  • No recipe asks for more than three chili peppers so they are not a crop you need to keep very large quantities of.
    • Despite being used in low quantities, it is used in a variety of dishes, some of which don't show clear signs of it being required such as Tomato Soup, Lobster Skewer, and Summer Rolls, so your supplies may diminish if not monitored.
